title: MeLD — Medical Longitudinal Latent Diffusion
summary: MeLD is a VAE + Diffusion Transformer pipeline for generating synthetic longitudinal medical (HIV cohort) time-series data, accompanied by evaluation scripts for distributional similarity, predictive performance, and privacy. Its model/gen_cohort.py script imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) alongside a Metadata object, using them as baseline synthetic-data generators to compare against the paper's MeLD model.
